klatch: An informal social gathering, especially one held over coffee for the purpose of conversation.
klavern: A local unit of the Ku Klux Klan.
klaxon: A loud electric alarm or horn, especially as used in automobiles in the early 20th century.
kleagle: A recruiter for the Ku Klux Klan.
klebsiella: Any of the genus Klebsiella of rod-shaped bacteria, which cause many diseases in humans.
klepht: An anti-Ottoman insurgent living in the mountains when Greece was a part of the Ottoman Empire.
kleptomania: A psychological disorder that causes an uncontrollable obsession with stealing without economic or material need.
klister: A soft wax used for grip on skis, especially for corn snow or crust.
kludge: An improvised device, typically crudely constructed to test the validity of a principle before implementing a finished design.
kluge: Something that should not work, but does.
klutzier: comparative form of klutzy: more klutzy
klutziest: superlative form of klutzy: most klutzy
klutziness: The quality of being klutzy, or being a klutz.
klystron: an electron tube used to amplify microwave-frequency electromagnetic radiation.
